test_inputs.explanation: The base_url and attribute_set_id are taken directly from the URLs the agent navigated to, e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/new/set/4/type/simple/', which shows base_url='http://dockerized-magento.local', attribute_set_id='4', and product_type_code='simple'. The corresponding visible labels for attribute_set_label ('Default') and product_type_label ('Simple Product') are standard Magento defaults for set id 4 and type 'simple'. The remaining product_* values (name, descriptions, SKU, weight, status, visibility, price, tax class, qty, stock status) are not visible in the provided trace, so realistic, valid Magento-compatible defaults have been supplied to allow successful replay of the flow for creating a simple product with attribute set 4. Admin credentials are likewise not shown in the trace, so common example values ('admin' / 'password123') are provided as test credentials.
